title: Pan-Seared Fish with Greek Galaktoboureko Crust
description: A German-inspired dish featuring pan-seared fish coated with a crumbly Greek galaktoboureko crust.

ingredients.name: Fish fillets
ingredients.notes: For this recipe, we recommend using a firm white fish such as cod or halibut.

ingredients.name: Galaktoboureko crumbs
ingredients.notes: You can make your own galaktoboureko crumbs by blending 1 cup of galaktoboureko pastry into fine crumbs.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter works best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper is a must.

ingredients.name: Lemon wedges
ingredients.notes: Use fresh lemons for the best flavor and a nice presentation.

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped parsley adds a fresh and herbaceous flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: Greek yogurt
ingredients.notes: Use a plain Greek yogurt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Dill
ingredients.notes: Fresh dill adds a nice flavor and aroma to the dish.

ingredients.name: Rich briny sauce
ingredients.notes: You can make your own rich briny sauce by combining 1 cup of mayonnaise with 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh dill and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.

instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
Coat the fish fillets with a layer of galaktoboureko crumbs.
Place the coated fish fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the fish fillets with butter and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is baking, prepare the rich briny sauce by combining the mayonnaise, dill, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Serve the pan-seared fish with the rich briny sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with lemon wedges and a sprinkle of chopped parsley.
